text:
Maya: Heads-up — Large customer asked for a private deploy template with guaranteed 95th-p90 latency < 120ms for chat, audit logs retained 7 years, and per-tenant dedicated GPU pools. They want go/no-go by end of Q. Can we quick-align on scope and blockers?

Rajesh: sounds big. Is the 120ms for 1k concurrent users or steady-state 100 qps? need traffic profile.

Maya: customer targets ~200 qps steady with spikes to 1k for short bursts. They said 5% error budget.

Lina: runtime note — p90 120ms likely requires prefix/KV caching for chat + tighter batching heuristics. We'll need a model-variant with lower param/quantized weights for the low-latency path. That implies onboarding + perf verification.

Chris: infra implications: dedicated GPU pools are straightforward functionally but require reserved capacity and autoscale rules tuned for burst-to-1k. Also network egress and private VPC peering setup (we'll need subnets + routes). Lead time for capacity/quotas: ~3w.

Olivia: security checklist: KMS integration for keys, audit log pipeline to our long-term storage (7y retention), and legal review for data residency. We also need a short threat model and compliance signoff before customer pilot.

Rajesh: can we split scope? Proposed MVP: 1) dedicated pool + VPC peering, 2) basic audit logs (30d) + canary for perf, 3) later extend to 7y retention + KMS. That reduces initial security lift. Thoughts?

Olivia: I'm okay with staged retention provided customer signs off on interim retention. But KMS is non-negotiable if they require BYOK. Need to know whether they want our KMS or their HSM.

Lina: for the runtime changes, we can ship batching/caching tweaks and a quantized variant in ~2 sprints (inc. perf tests). If we offload long retention outside the core delivery, we can hit a canary earlier.

Maya: propose launch criteria for canary: p90 <= 150ms (canary), error rate < 1%, audit events delivered to staging pipeline, customer sign-off on interim retention. Full GA requires final KMS + 7y retention + performance drop <= 5% vs canary.

Chris: schedule-wise: provision pool + network (3w), runtime changes (2 sprints), security/compliance (2–3w parallel). End-to-end canary looks like earliest 6w if we parallelize.

Rajesh: agree. I'll own runtime + rollout plan. Lina will be runtime eng lead, Chris owns infra, Olivia security.

Maya: great — action items: Rajesh draft technical spec + perf targets by Tue, Chris start capacity request and peering plan, Olivia send KMS/retention checklist, Lina mock perf test harness. I'll coordinate customer alignment and requirements doc.

sam-deploy-bot: Reminder: planned infra provisioning may need maintenance windows. Check with eng-oncall for available windows.

Maya: thanks — I'll sync with oncall. Can everyone drop a quick ack and ETA in this thread?

Rajesh: ack — spec by Tue EOD.

Lina: ack — perf harness by next Wed.

Chris: ack — capacity request initiated, ETA 3w.

Olivia: ack — KMS checklist and regulatory notes by Friday.

Maya: perfect. I'll update the customer and set a follow-up sync Friday 11am PT. :thumbsup:
